title: Mrs. Vivien Hidary: "Parashat Va'ethanan"

chapters.title: Introduction to Vaethanan
chapters.about: Overview of the Parasha and Moshe's request

chapters.title: Seeking Grace
chapters.about: The meaning of Vaethanan and the relationship with Hashem

chapters.title: Handling Rejection
chapters.about: How to process when Hashem says no

chapters.title: Moshe's Strategy
chapters.about: Approaching Hashem with humility and recognition of His greatness

chapters.title: The Lesson of Rav lach
chapters.about: Focusing on what we have rather than what we lack

summary: Mrs. Hidary discusses the opening of Parashat Vaethanan, focusing on Moshe Rabbenu's earnest request to enter Eretz Yisrael. She explores how Moshe's approach to Hashem serves as a model for how people can handle disappointment and maintain gratitude when their own prayers are not answered as they desire.
questions: How should one approach Hashem when making a request?
How can we reconcile a 'no' from Hashem with His mercy?
What does it mean to be grateful for what we have when we are missing something?
Why did Hashem tell Moshe to stop speaking about entering the land?
